title: Paytm to invest up to Rs 200 cr in Singapore’s Funding Societies, pick up 19% stake in CardUp
summary:
While Rs 162 cr of the Rs 200 crapproved by Paytm's board will be used to acquire a 19.1% stake in CardUp, the digital payments arm of Singapore's Funding Societies, the rest Rs 38 cr will be invested in its affiliates.

The post Paytm to invest up to Rs 200 cr in Singapore’s Funding Societies, pick up 19% stake in CardUp appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: Paytm’s board has approved up to ₹200 crore of investment, with ₹162 crore earmarked to buy a 19.1% stake in CardUp—the digital‑payments arm of Singapore’s fintech platform Funding Societies. The remaining ₹38 crore will be directed toward other Paytm affiliates. This move expands Paytm’s footprint in Southeast Asia’s online lending and payments ecosystem.
